cohort: The study cohort consisted of 103 consecutive umbilical cord blood units collected during 2013, representing 103 newborns.
finding: The study found that birth weight, placental weight, umbilical cord length (>= 31 cm), and gestational age (38-40 weeks) independently and significantly influenced the volume and hematopoietic stem cell count of umbilical cord blood units.

gest_age: Measured; specifically gestational age between 38-40 weeks was found to significantly increase umbilical factors
